about: THE KODE DOT's pictures (C-442): the DAEMONS app in Kode's simulator, kode-sim, which runs the real program on Espressif's emulator of the Dot's chip -- filed in qa/screenshots/2026-11-19 (C-424 ROUTINES and LODESTONE, C-426 the den against a scratch companion's synthetic save), each cropped to one 410x502 screen. Nothing of the Dot itself is captured yet: it comes in December 2026.
